This shader is invalid on purpose: RaytracingAccelerationStructure is an SRV-class
resource, so register(u0) is wrong. The question is what DXC says about it.

In the DXC panes, look at the error: it is a register collision that names
depth_buffer, which is declared correctly at t0 and is not the mistake. Nothing in
the output mentions the register class of the acceleration structure, so nothing
points at the declaration that has to change.

For contrast, change the acceleration structure's line to a different SRV-class
resource with the same wrong register -- StructuredBuffer<float> opaque_as :
register(u0) -- and DXC names the mistake on that declaration instead.
